changed: {path} changed on the server since it was opened
channelRefused: the server allows no more sessions on this connection
danglingLink: {path} is a link to a missing file
deleteHome: refusing to delete the home directory
deleted: {path} no longer exists on the server
nameControl: name must not contain control characters
network: the file transfer channel to the host failed
notText: {path} is not a text file (binary content or not UTF-8)
partialWrite: {path} may be incomplete on the server: the save failed while writing
retargeted: {path} now points to another file on the server
sessionRejected: the host refused to open a session for file transfers
sourceChanged: the local copy changed during the upload
subsystemRefused: the host refused to start its SFTP service
timeout: the host did not answer in time while opening the file transfer channel
